zone: table convention: summer offset +120 from Apr 1 to Oct 31 inclusive (fixed-date DST, not the EU dates), winter +60

convention.summary: dark season one recipe (fajr 15 deg, isha 16 deg, margins ~0/+1; sunrise +0.3, dhuhr transit +5.4, asr Shafi +4.2, maghrib sunset +3.3); bright season the twilight pair runs a shallower-than-angle arc (printed extremes measured); fixed-date DST Apr 1..Oct 31
convention.publisher_claim: the calendar is published as valid 2025-2028 unchanged (about 1 min/yr drift) with a one-time leap correction in 2029; a 2025 folder exists on the same Drive
